typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style CBDates.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style CBDates.

recognitionRules: Use a prominent name and short professional focus before experience.
Keep Carlito for an open, readable resume rhythm.
Group transferable evidence by relevance while preserving actual dates and role boundaries.
Use restrained section rules and ordinary bullets rather than skill-rating graphics.
Use dark green section headings and target-role labels, quieter green-gray contact metadata and a black name; keep the white page.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: The setting may change. The work offers a useful starting point.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use ACROSS PRACTICE as a simple Carlito wordmark with a small baseline extension. No bridge illustration; the connection is made by the evidence.
invariants: Use a prominent name and short professional focus before experience.
Keep Carlito for an open, readable resume rhythm.
Group transferable evidence by relevance while preserving actual dates and role boundaries.
adaptations: Adapt the opening focus to the role while keeping the underlying experience intact.
A letter can echo the header without reproducing the resume.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
